definitions.explanation: first of all; before anything else; right away

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{真|ま}っ{先|さき}に{帰|かえ}った。
{問題|もんだい}が{起|お}きたら{真|ま}っ{先|さき}に{連絡|れんらく}してください。
examples.english: Please contact us first if any problem occurs.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{危険|きけん}を{顧|かえり}みず{真|ま}っ{先|さき}に{飛|と}び{込|こ}んで{人|ひと}を{助|たす}けた。
examples.english: She jumped in first without regard for danger and rescued the person.

notes:
{真|ま}っ{先|さき} combines the intensifying prefix {真|ま}っ with {先|さき} (ahead, first), meaning "the very first" or "before anyone/anything else."

Usage patterns:
- {真|ま}っ{先|さき}に (adverbially: first, before others)

Often used to emphasize being the first to do something, particularly when volunteering or responding quickly.

Related {真|ま}っ~ words:
- {真|ま}っ{白|しろ} (pure white)
- {真|ま}っ{暗|くら} (pitch dark)
- {真|ま}っ{赤|か} (bright red)
